summary: The PMO's published chronology says Netanyahu was alerted at 06:29, received another update at 06:44, left for the Kirya at 07:30 and held the first full senior-security assessment at 09:55; Channel 12 now reports conflicting arrival/departure timing and says he did not speak with security chiefs before reaching the Kirya.
notes: Freshness added material but non-dispositive chronology evidence. Channel 12 reports PMO minutes say 08:00 arrival while Shin Bet minutes say 08:22, unpublished PM diary material says 09:00 and another source says 09:30; it also says Netanyahu did not phone security chiefs before reaching the Kirya. PMO chronology still records early military-secretary updates and questions/instructions, with first full assessment at 09:55. Preserve all competing accounts. No official, judicial, audit or inquiry finding assigning Netanyahu individual responsibility for this timing was recovered, so do not classify chronology alone as an operational/governance failure or infer motive.
